name: Lattice
summary: HR / people-management platform (Lattice). For agents it runs a first-party MCP server at api.latticehq.com/mcp: under the user's own Lattice login, Claude, ChatGPT and Slack read and write across performance reviews, updates, feedback, goals and 1:1s, and read Grow, plus admin tools for review packets, calibration and CSV exports. A keyless initialize returned 401 Bearer on 2026-11-15. Engagement surveys are listable and raw responses exportable as CSV, but no tool turns open-text comments into themes; that is the connected model's act. Per-seat pricing is published; $4,000 annual minimum.

payments.notes: Billed by invoice; per-seat prices at lattice.com/pricing, $4,000 annual minimum. Payment routes, help.lattice.com Invoice FAQ (2026-11-16): "ACH wire, bank transfer, credit card or check"; credit-card autopay optional. A human pays the invoice; not agent-payable.

agentAccess.notes: Not keyless. Fixed public endpoint https://api.latticehq.com/mcp; a keyless initialize returned 401 with a Bearer challenge on 2026-11-15, its protected-resource metadata naming api-auth.latticehq.com as the OAuth2 server. Sign-in is the user's Lattice credentials; an admin enables the connector.
